packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry's 0.x packages move to a new hundred, such as 0.2xx to 0.3xx, with each stable major, and each SDK package caps its @opentelemetry/api peer below the next api minor. Renovate types those 0.x and api moves as minor, so a separate minor branch would get them without the major they need. One branch for the group keeps them with the major.

A 0.x OpenTelemetry update that changes the hundreds digit breaks like a major, so it takes the preset's major settings: no automerge, and the weekly window. Renovate automerges a branch only when every update in it allows automerge.
